title: Benchmark rather than a newly trained method
input: Find exactly one paper whose main contribution is a heterogeneous zero-shot retrieval evaluation benchmark across many domains and datasets. Do not include a paper merely because it reports experiments on several QA datasets.
constraints: 只根据本题授权论文原文判断本篇贡献，缺失证据不凭背景提及补全。
expected_output: 相关论文完整文件名和有原文依据的理由；无匹配可为空。
